verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents an official quickstart for installing and initializing the gcloud CLI with exact commands (curl https://sdk.cloud.google.com | bash), and $300 in free credit lets a new user start without paying. There is also an official MCP server for deploying apps to Cloud Run. However, the pack shows no official quickstart that goes from zero to a running service with exact deploy commands, and nothing supports the under-an-hour claim. Missing for 10: an evidenced zero-to-running-service deploy quickstart (e.g., Cloud Run or App Engine) with exact commands, evidence of time-to-first-deploy, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the onboarding experience.
